NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Amixos uses your location to record where a job was done when you add it.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Amixos uses the camera to scan VIN codes and take photos of equipment.
NSContactsUsageDescription: Amixos uses your contacts so you can import clients from your phone.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Amixos uses your photos so you can attach images to jobs, invoices and equipment.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Amixos saves the images and documents you choose to download from the app to your photos, such as an invoice PDF or a receipt photo.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Amixos uses the microphone so you can talk to Ami, your business assistant.
NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Amixos uses speech recognition to understand what you say to Ami.
